title: One receiver per frame direction gives a simultaneous canonical measurement score

statement.quantifiers: For every d>=2, supplied self-compatible Phi on M_d, and every Hermitian frame A_1,...,A_r with r<=d^2; m=ceil(log2(d^2)), K=2^m.
statement.assertion: A depth-m binary broadcaster tree has every receiver marginal Phi^m. Pulling back simultaneous spectral PVMs produces one POVM M and canonical EB map Psi_M(X)=sum_z tau(M_z X)M_z/tau(M_z), tau=Tr/d, with <A_i,Psi_M A_i>_tau >= 2<A_i,Phi^m A_i>_tau-||A_i||_2,tau^2 for ALL frame elements simultaneously.
assumptions: Phi CPTP, unital and HS self-adjoint; a CPTP two-output broadcaster has both marginals Phi.
No HS-positive-spectrum premise; spectrum may lie anywhere in [-1,1].
Zero POVM effects omitted; no output side record acquired.

inputs: Explicit finite-dimensional Phi and broadcaster; frame supplied.
outputs: One input POVM and common frame score; not independent choices for different directions.
interface.precision: Exact channel operations and spectral PVMs; finite-precision implementation absent.
costs: Raw product POVM may have d^K outcomes; acquisition and physical execution not free.

proof_mechanism: Induct receiver marginals through the tree.
Expand marginal score deficit as sum_y(tau(E_y A)-a_y tau(E_y))^2/tau(E_y).
Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz makes refining a marginal POVM increase its canonical score.
obstructions: Separate frame-specific POVMs do not yield a universal comparator.
Receiver reuse across directions is not justified; cost grows with frame dimension.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a single-measurement bound independent of frame rank; bounded Holevo alone supplies no such service.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
